Hi Nicholas. Your Nexus S1 on Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet.

Straight answer: it's not on the shelf. The unit comes in with the next batch landing at our US warehouse, and your order ships October 31. I'm sorry, I told you earlier it would go out within five days of payment, and that wasn't right.

You can follow that incoming shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status (dates can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses). Tracking comes to your email the moment the label prints.
